#### Course: Learn C++ STL

## What's Next?

Congratulations! 🎉

This marks the end of the C++ STL course.

Take a moment to congratulate yourself on completing this journey—well done!

We hope you found the course both informative and enjoyable. As mentioned throughout, the C++ Standard Template Library (STL) allows you to focus on solving problems effectively without getting bogged down by low-level coding tasks.

By completing this course, you've built a strong foundation in STL, which is invaluable for working with data structures and solving complex problems in C++.

We hope you've been practicing along the way with Practice: C++ STL. If you haven't yet, no worries—take some time to finish any remaining exercises. These will help reinforce the concepts you've learned and further build your proficiency with STL.

For your next step, we recommend our DSA with C++ course to advance your programming skills even further and deepen your knowledge of data structures and algorithms.

Once again, congratulations on your achievement! We look forward to seeing you in the next course.
